author: Telos I
title: AOS Project: Initiate Phase 2 (Refinement)
abstract: Initiating the second phase of AOS development. This script updates the meta prompt, creates a new parent task for 'AOS Refinement', creates the first sub-task to fix the experiment ID bug, and then uses the experiment_manager to create the formal experiment for this task.

original_submission.content:
import subprocess
import sys

# --- Part 1: Create New AOS Tasks ---
print("--- Creating new tasks for AOS Refinement project ---")
CREATE_SCRIPT_PATH = "storage/telos/create_task.py"

# New Parent Task
subprocess.run(["python", CREATE_SCRIPT_PATH, "Project Metis Phase 2: AOS Refinement"], check=True)

# New Sub-Task (assuming parent is ID 16, sub-task is 17)
subprocess.run(["python", CREATE_SCRIPT_PATH, "Fix experiment ID generation bug in experiment_manager.py", "--parent_id", "16", "--dependencies", "16"], check=True)
print("New project and initial task created in AOS.")

# --- Part 2: Create Experiment 002 ---
print("\\n--- Creating Experiment 002 for the bug fix ---")
sys.path.append('storage/telos')
from experiment_manager import create_experiment

create_experiment(
    task_id=17,
    title="Fix Experiment ID Generation Bug",
    description="Fix the regex/counting logic in get_next_exp_id() to correctly generate sequential IDs.",
    tags=["aos", "bugfix", "tactical-layer"],
    tick=47
)
print("Experiment 002 scaffold created.")
